note: People born in Puerto Rico are citizens of the United States at birth (8 U.S.C. 1402), and Puerto Rico is part of the United States for the nationality law (8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38)), so its rules on naturalisation and on keeping citizenship are the United States'.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1402 Persons born in Puerto Rico on or after April 11, 1899
sources.said: All persons born in Puerto Rico on or after January 13, 1941, and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1101 Definitions
sources.said: (29) The term "outlying possessions of the United States" means American Samoa and Swains Island. ... (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
